description: date-fns for date parsing, formatting, arithmetic, and relative time. Tree-shakeable, locale-ready. For any product that displays, schedules, or reasons about dates.

buildHints.whenToUse: Attach when the product renders, schedules, or reasons about dates. Import from 'date-fns' — the tree-shakeable per-function API keeps bundle size down.
firstSteps: Pick locale on demand via 'date-fns/locale/en-US' (etc.) for i18n
